test_title: PYST 49: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In June 2025, which district was officially declared the first single-use plastic (SUP)–free district in Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nuapada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **June 2025**, the district of **Nuapada** achieved the significant milestone of being officially declared the **first single-use plastic (SUP)–free district** in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• The declaration was the culmination of a rigorous and sustained campaign led by the **District Administration** to eliminate the usage of prohibited plastic items across both **urban and rural areas**.
 
• Success was achieved through the effective implementation of the **Plastic Waste Management Rules**, which included **strict enforcement**, regular **raids on wholesalers**, and the promotion of sustainable alternatives.
 
• The initiative involved widespread **community participation**, where local **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)** and **Panchayati Raj Institutions** were empowered to monitor and report the use of **Single-Use Plastics**.
 
• To support the transition, the district set up several **Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs)** to ensure that plastic waste already in circulation was collected and processed efficiently. ***Hence, the correct answer is Nuapada.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Understanding Single-Use Plastic (SUP):**
 
 
• **Single-use plastics** refer to plastic items that are intended to be used only **once** for the same purpose before being **disposed of** or recycled.
 
• These items, such as **plastic straws**, **stirrers**, **polythene bags**, and **plastic cutlery**, are major contributors to **environmental pollution** as they do not biodegrade.
 
 
 
• **Plastic Ban in Odisha:**
 
 
• The **Government of Odisha** has been a pioneer in environmental conservation, having initially banned plastic in **six major cities** (Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Berhampur, Sambalpur, Rourkela, and Puri) on **Gandhi Jayanti** in **2018**.
 
• The statewide ban aligns with the **National Ban** on identified SUP items introduced by the **Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** which came into effect on **July 1, 2022**.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• Plastic waste is a significant threat to **marine life** and **soil fertility** in **Odisha**, particularly affecting sensitive zones like **Chilika Lake** and the **Bhitarkanika Mangroves**.
 
• By becoming **SUP-free**, districts like **Nuapada** help in reducing the **carbon footprint** and preventing the clogging of **drainage systems** during the monsoon.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **District Context:** While **Nuapada** took the lead in **2025**, other districts such as **Bargarh**, **Rayagada**, and **Kalahandi** have also been actively pursuing **waste management** protocols to achieve similar status.
 
• **Legal Framework:** The enforcement is carried out under the **Environment Protection Act, 1986**, where violators can face heavy **fines** or even **imprisonment** for non-compliance with plastic waste regulations.
 
• **Alternatives Promoted:** As part of the **SUP-free** movement, the government has encouraged the use of **cloth bags**, **jute products**, and leaf-based plates (**Sal leaves**), which are traditional to **Odisha's culture** and support local **artisans**.
 
• **Role of SPCB:** The **State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)** provides technical guidance and monitors the **air and water quality** improvements resulting from reduced plastic incineration and littering.
